title: PBa-LLM: Privacy- and Bias-aware NLP using Named-Entity Recognition (NER)

bias_targets.methodology: Removing explicit gender indicators (e.g., pronouns, titles) and implicit markers (e.g., gendered phrases or role associations) from candidate biographies, and then evaluating the male and female representation in a top-100 candidate shortlist for a resume scoring task using a dataset with deliberately gender-biased expert score annotations.
